title: Number of Ways to Form a Target String Given a Dictionary
summary: Given a list of strings of equal length and a target string, determine the number of ways to form the target by selecting characters from the list.
statement: Given a list of strings of equal length and a target string, determine the number of ways to form the target by selecting characters from the list. Characters can only be used once they are selected, and the selection process must follow the order of the target string. The result should be modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: There are 1 through 1000 equal-length lowercase words, each up to 1000 characters; target is no longer than that width.
Build target left-to-right by choosing strictly increasing column indices and any word at each chosen column.
Return the number of choices modulo 1000000007.
hints: Only column character frequencies matter, not which word supplied earlier characters.
Process columns left-to-right and update target-prefix counts right-to-left.
Descending updates prevent one column from supplying two target positions, and every increasing column choice has one final chosen column counted exactly once.
editorial: Descending updates prevent one column from supplying two target positions, and every increasing column choice has one final chosen column counted exactly once.

tests.explanation: Choose increasing columns whose character frequencies multiply; all valid choices total six.
The valid column choices, including their word multiplicities, total four.
